{{Top|leg}}
'''Anderun''' was an individual who landed their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manforgon]]. They were approached by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Customs official/Legends|Customs Officer]] [[Tellix]] who inquired about their last port of call and business on Manforgon. Anderun replied that they were carrying a cargo of [[sand wine]] from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Anderun was mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]'' published in [[2001]]. The character was used to illustrate the differing styles that a gamemaster could use while running an adventure, using either first- or third-person styles.<ref name="RPG-Core" />
